definitions.full: H1102. balam [ בָּלַם ] verb curb, hold in (Late Hebrew id. ,) Aramaic בְּלַם , ) — Qal Infinitive לִבְלוֺם Psa 32:9 , compare Che. בלס (compare Ethiopic fig , Arabic a kind of fig , compare Lag M. i. 59 f. 68f.; hence following).
